#: OpenLamina's own frames (run.py --cases own-frames,own-frames-race,own-frames-nothing-shown --ini ini/own_frames.ini, on the stand-in at 90 Hz). own-frames: with an overlay shown, 10 game frames, a second without calls, 10 more; OpenLamina keeps frames going in the pause (at least 60), each with the game's last frame again under the overlay. own-frames-race: 20 rounds of 5 frames and a 150 ms pause while another thread reads input; the game's frames and OpenLamina's never overlap. own-frames-nothing-shown: the same stall with nothing of its own to show runs no frames of its own. own-frames-overlay-churn: an overlay's image replaced 60 times in alternating sizes from another thread while own frames draw it.
